description: The families a pptx template's output uses (§3), each named once whatever its case: the theme's fonts, East Asian and complex ones included; the typefaces of the parts the output keeps, which are the default text style, the table styles, the master and its layouts, the notes master (related by a type in another case) with its own theme, and the handout master sharing that theme. Brand Display resolves through the font resolver. BRAND SANS, which the template embeds, isn't reported in pptx output, and calibri has a bundled stand-in. Brand Ghost, Brand Remote and Brand Lost are listed as embedded, but their regular faces aren't parts of the package: the first has no relationship, the second's is external and the third's part is missing. Broken Font's pinned bytes aren't a font. These, and Brand Mincho, Brand Naskh, Brand Default, Brand Table, Source Serif 4 (also named as source serif 4), Brand Gothic, Brand Notes, Brand Notes Body and Brand Handout, resolve nowhere: 13 `font_unresolved`.
